name: chamfer_5_at_45
why: A 5x5 chamfer at 45 degrees on an edge 100 long removes 5*5/2*100 = 1250 mm3. AN R5 FILLET WOULD REMOVE 537: if `swChamferAngleDistance` were read as a fillet, the number would say so at once. It is the only difference between the two operations that shows without looking at the part.

expect._why_exact: 120000 minus 5*5/2*100 is an exact calculation, without pi
